zhu_2021.product: generic fresh agricultural products; not a calibrated named species
zhu_2021.dataset: R108 first50 customers; demand and capacity multiplied by10 per author
zhu_2021.scope: author numerical setting, not measured generic-food physics or current market prices

el_raoui_2021.location: section7.1 Table4 p14; cost Eq1-8 p6-7
el_raoui_2021.time_and_refrigeration_unit_issue: Table4 says EUR/unit, not explicitly EUR/min or kWh tariff; Eq3-4 require cost per time. Any benchmark-time interpretation must be declared, not reported as measured power.
el_raoui_2021.not_adopted_as_quality_threshold: alpha0.8 in Table4 is NOT established as a food-quality rejection threshold by this review
el_raoui_2021.comparison_scope_issue: section6.2 Eq35 CPLEX/GVNS comparison omits damage costC4; cannot use its results as a full quality-value baseline

gharehyakheh_2020.scope: do not identify this120-day numerical shelf life as chilled mullet or ready-to-eat salad shelf life

zhao_2020.product: fresh milk numerical application; Solomon data, not observed enterprise order logs
zhao_2020.baseline_refrigeration_context: paper section2.5 numerical/experimental-simulation statement at outside25C and inside10C; not a verified road-duty dataset or current truck measurement
zhao_2020.scope: paper microbial zero-growth below0C is a model assumption; not universal milk safety evidence

normalization.identity: divide every monetary term by the same positive monetary reference; customers, costs, loss and revenue must share source identity and unit convention

objective_deduction.constant_reference_value: B=P*sum(q_i), if every original order is fixed and mandatory
objective_deduction.equivalence: maxPi is equivalent to minimizing the sum of those costs including value loss; if L_value=0 and sale revenue is constant, it reduces to ordinary cost minimization
objective_deduction.not_double_count: do not subtract both an identical revenue markdown and a duplicate deterioration loss
